notes: Fixed unnecessary browser login popups when PBP reports an already-active watch_and_claim request for an authenticated user.
Watch contention now keeps the session authenticated and follows the normal retry path instead of forcing login.
Genuine authentication error handling and the five-minute/two-minute browser popup cooldown are unchanged.
Beta builds now check beta/version.json for beta-only updates; stable builds keep their existing update feed.
Install this beta manually once when upgrading from b4 or earlier; subsequent beta updates support numbered beta versions.
Reports only when failed authorization forces a browser popup; routine calls and throttling stay quiet.
Debug tabs: PBP Authorization first and selected by default, plus Throttling.
Ten seconds between failed token renewal attempts, including between batches.
New authorization windows limited to five minutes normally or two minutes in Mission Mode.
Use Debug > PBP Authorization > Open log folder to collect logs for manual sending.
